item.title: Sydney Sweeney's New Netflix Sci-Fi Epic Is Mandatory Viewing For Transformers Fans
item.description: Transformers is a franchise that has built-in appeal in more ways than one. Apart from the concept of giant robots transforming into vehicles, there's the fact that two factions of these robots have been engaged in a war that spans millenia. There have been highs (including the grossly underrated Transformers One ) and lows (including most of Michael Bay's films ), but it's more than likely that we'll be seeing Transformers stories until the heat death of the universe. Netflix is aiming to deliver its own take on another property that features giant robots, and it's tapped Sydney Sweeney to play a leading role in this potential franchise.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Star Trek Perfectly Captures the Sci-Fi Show’s Most Brutal Running Joke
item.description: Generating creature tokens is a common way to make the most out of your resources in a game of Magic: The Gathering . They can be sacrificed for powerful effects, used to chump block , or amassed to overwhelm your opponent. Cards typically generate tokens of the same color, like white Warriors for Secure the Wastes , green Squirrels for Deranged Hermit , and black Zombies for Ghoulish Procession . Yet numerous cards in Magic: The Gathering Star Trek generate 1/1 red Officer tokens regardless of the base color, from the white Captain Benjamin Sisko to the green MACO Strike Team . The discrepancy is a nod to the sci-fi franchise’s darkest running joke.

item.title: 5 Sci-Fi Series To Watch If You Love HBO's 'Lanterns'
item.description: HBO's Lanterns more than delivered when it comes to being both a great comic book series and a great piece of television. Not only did the series thrive thanks to the dynamic between Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler) and John Stewart (Aaron Pierre), but it also managed to revitalize interest in the Green Lantern franchise following the less-than-stellar Green Lantern movie from 2011. That's a superhuman feat in and of itself, and Lanterns creators Damon Lindelof, Chris Mundy, and Tom King deserve credit for pulling that off.

item.title: 38 Years Later, Calvin and Hobbes' Lost Character Remains Bill Watterson's Biggest Failure
item.description: The author Lois McMaster Bujold has said that “the writer should always reserve the right to come up with a better idea.” That's a useful guideline for any reader to keep in mind. As any long-form story evolves, it usually picks up a few dead plot branches or abandoned characters , because the author can exercise their option to drop what they're doing for any (or no) reason. Sometimes it's not a continuity error; it's a deliberate change in direction.

item.title: The 8 Best Castlevania Games Of All Time, Ranked
item.description: Castlevania is one of the most beloved franchises in video game history, despite a period of 13 years when we didn’t see a new installment until the launch of Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse earlier this year.

item.title: 10 Essential GBA Games Still Disappointingly Missing From Nintendo Switch Online
item.description: When the original Game Boy came out, games like the ones people enjoyed on their NES were finally playable on the go, and players loved Nintendo for it. The green and black color palette was a bit of a bummer, but finally was rectified with the Game Boy Color. Even so, most of the games were still pretty basic. The next step was to make a handheld unit that could replicate the superior experience offered on the Super Nintendo, and the Game Boy Advance did precisely that.

item.title: 10 Devastating Game Cancellations That Are Still Disappointing Years Later
item.description: Sometimes, it’s fun to think about the great games that might have been — until they were canceled without ever getting the chance to make their mark. Most of the time, we just shrug our shoulders and move on, because that’s life. But sometimes, we mourn the wasted potential.

item.title: GTA 6's Biggest Competition Officially Arrives on PC in 2027
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to dominate 2026 with its long-awaited release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, another game — one heavily inspired by GTA, Marvel's Spider-Man , and Genshin Impact — will give Rockstar Games a run for its money: Ananta .

item.title: Ryan Gosling is Officially Reviving The Flintstones for New Project
item.description: Ryan Gosling has been incredibly booked and busy of late. He starred in the lead role in the sci-fi smash hit Project Hail Mary earlier this year. In 2027, he'll travel to the galaxy far, far away in St ar Wars: Starfighter . Then in 2028 he'll make his long-awaited MCU debut as Ghost Rider , re-teaming with Starfighter director Shawn Levy. If all that wasn't enough, Gosling has lined up one more unexpected project: The Flintstones .

item.title: Every GTA Game, Ranked by Metacritic Score
item.description: With plenty of installments boasting Metacritic scores in the high 90s, GTA 6 has an exceptionally high bar to meet. That said, the series has had occasional growing pains over the years, even if true stinkers are a rarity among Rockstar Games’ back catalog. These are the top 10 GTA games of all time, ranked according to their Metacritic scores.
